This '''individual''' served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> he accompanied Teradoc to a [[Unidentified club (Ryvester)|club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]] to meet [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Hachat, who was secretly [[Garik Loran]] of [[Wraith Squadron]] in disguise, to discuss a partnership to recover treasure from [[The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes]].<ref name="MK" />

Hachat brought a statuette supposedly recovered from the palace as proof of the treasure's existence. However, Teradoc summoned his [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Mulus Cheems]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] specializing in crystalline materials, to verify the statuette's authenticity. The bodyguard escorted Cheems to the table, where the scientist inspected the item and ultimately confirmed that it was worth a [[Moff/Legends|Moff's]] ransom. Satisfied, Teradoc then attempted to double cross Hachat by abducting him for [[Interrogation (Imperial Intelligence)|interrogation]] in order to keep all of the treasure for himself. Hachat gave a signal, and the other undercover Wraiths, who were working various jobs throughout the club, sprang into action.<ref name="MK" />

During the brief skirmish, the bodyguard attempted to shoot the escaping Hachat and Cheems with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] when [[Voort saBinring]], who had been posing as a dancer on the club's stage, took a running start from the stage before hurling himself at him, smashing him into the floor, breaking several of his bones and rendering him unconscious.<ref name="MK" />
